comments.author: Port Official
comments.body: only these 2 ships? :(

comments.author: Liza
comments.body:
Two ships, making it look like you're wielding a spoon when you have Excalibur equipped, new treasure hunts, what looks like an optional super ship boss in the form of a bǎochuán, new NPC (Lucrecia Borgia), Genoa getting its own faction flag, wearable cat ears, adding a skill to your aide, new EQ/recipes... or so the Korean page and its spiffy images suggest.

I'm still waiting for KOEI to get with the program and release the Tessarakonteres, personally.
